page.overview:
Who is Lily Blossom?

Lily Blossom is a female Pegasus pony who appears in software. She has a purple coat, two-toned yellow mane and tail, purple eyes, and a cutie mark usually of three lilies and sometimes of one lily. She first appeared in merchandise.__TOC__

Lily Blossom is similar to Lily Valley except for coat, eye, and partly cutie mark colors, also resembles Cloud Kicker and S04E08 Unnamed Pegasus Mare #2, and also has a color scheme close to those of "Cloudy Kicks", "Lavender Lace", "Ballad", "Lilac Notes", and Issue 20 Unnamed Mare - Olivia Dunham.

Lily Blossom is a playable character in Gameloft's mobile game, added in the version 11.2 update.

Lily Blossom also appears in Hasbro's Friendship Celebration app.
